thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy noticed: release/v1.12.0 -> production; window 2024-04-01 02:00 UTC (2h maintenance window). Auto-run smoke tests and canary rollout enabled.

maria: heads-up — we have a Dedicated customer (Finpay) with a change freeze 02:00-04:00 UTC that day. They asked to avoid auto-updates.

jamie: noted. Finpay is on reserved capacity; we should pin the model/service for their pool.

anil: agree. Proposal: proceed with global deploy but pin Finpay's dedicated pool to v1.11.3 for 72h, then coordinate manual upgrade.

maria: +1. That avoids forced behaviour. Who owns the pin and comms?

laura: I'll draft the comms for customer-facing notice and the status page blurb. Can someone confirm the risk summary?

maria: risk summary: small change in tokenization path and kv-cache alignment that may cause rare 502s during peak if not pinned. Rollback path validated. No data schema changes.

anil: rollback plan: if canary error rate > 0.5% for 15m, abort and rollback to v1.11.x across affected hosts. Manual rollback for Dedicated pools (we'll keep snapshot).

jamie: status page update needed. Suggest template: short outage/maintenance notice with start/end times, impact (potentially degraded generation latency), and link to postmortem template if needed.

laura: draft template posted below — please quick review and sign off.

laura: ```
Scheduled maintenance: Release v1.12.0 (April 1)
Start: 2024-04-01 02:00 UTC
End: 2024-04-01 04:00 UTC
Impact: Rolling deploy may cause transient increased latencies or failed requests for up to 5 minutes on individual requests. Dedicated customers on pinned pools will not be updated unless they opt in.
Customer action: None required. If you require extended pinning, contact support@redwood.ai.
Reference: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2024-04-01-v1-12
```

maria: fine. Two edits: change "up to 5 minutes" -> "up to 10 minutes" for conservatism, and add contact link to CSM for Dedicated.

laura: updated. New draft below.

laura: ```
Scheduled maintenance: Release v1.12.0 (April 1)
Start: 2024-04-01 02:00 UTC
End: 2024-04-01 04:00 UTC
Impact: Rolling deploy may cause transient increased latencies or failed requests for up to 10 minutes on individual requests. Dedicated customers on pinned pools will not be updated unless they opt in.
Customer action: None required. If you require extended pinning or manual upgrade, contact your CSM or support@redwood.ai.
Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2024-04-01-v1-12
```

jamie: looks good. I'll create the status incident and schedule the push at T-30m. Can someone add the pinned-pools change to the ops-runbook?

anil: adding runbook step now: ``pin-dedicated-pool --pool-id <POOL> --version v1.11.3 --ttl 72h``. We'll run that for Finpay (pool-id: finpay-prod-001).

maria: I'll own execution for pinned pools. Assigning to me.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 2024-04-01 02:00:01 UTC. 5% traffic. Monitoring: logs and latency dashboards enabled.

anil: monitoring looks green so far. If errors spike, we execute rollback plan.

jamie: status page incident created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2024-04-01-v1-12 (published, maintenance mode). I'll set updates at T+10m, T+60m, and at completion.

laura: I'll queue the customer email draft once we confirm no rollback — want to avoid alarming messages. Template for email in thread below in case we need it fast.

laura: ```
Subject: Notice: Scheduled maintenance – Redwood release v1.12.0
Hi <CustomerName>,
We are rolling out a scheduled platform release on April 1 between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. You are on a pinned dedicated pool (v1.11.3) and will not be impacted unless you opt into the upgrade.
If you want us to keep you pinned beyond the default 72 hours, reply to this email or contact your CSM.
Regards,
Redwood Customer Success
```

maria: approved. If we do need to rollback, post a status update immediately and send this short alert to affected customers: "We're rolling back the recent change due to increased errors; service will be restored to previous behavior within ~10 minutes."

support-bot: Alert rule created: notify #support and oncall if 502 rate > 0.5% sustained > 10m.

anil: final: maria will pin Finpay pool now, jamie has status page, laura has comms, I'll hold rollback trigger. Proceeding with deploy.

maria: pin applied to finpay-prod-001. Confirmed TTL 72h.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 20% at 02:22 UTC. No action required.

jamie: posting update on status page: "Canary healthy, rolling to additional hosts." Next update at 03:00 UTC.

laura: thanks all — keeping the email draft ready. Will coordinate CSM outreach if Finpay asks for extended pinning.

anil: closing thread; monitoring in place. Reopen if we hit the triggers. :white_check_mark:
